topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I walk these familiar halls, each step echoing softly, the walls that have held so many stories, now silent with the weight of change. The air carries whispers of futures that will belong to others, not us. But I focus on the warmth of home, the comfort of the spaces where our laughter has danced and our dreams have nested. I prepare a meal, simple and comforting, the kitchen filled with the same scents that have wrapped us in a embrace of shared days. I set the table, a small gesture, a reminder that here, in this moment, the world can still feel steady. Together, we talk not of uncertainty, but of the joys this place has held, our conversation a gentle river, smoothing the edges of any storm.
